description: Parallel copy engine for Windows, bound to Ctrl+Shift+V

milestones.name: Milestone 1: Engine (Headless)
milestones.description: Build the CLI tool (bcopy) with seek-penalty and UASP detection, small/large file queues, error handling, two-phase move, and self-contained benchmark script.

tasks.name: Create prd.json and workspace configuration
tasks.description: Establish progress tracking and base files.

tasks.name: Initialize Cargo Workspace & Gitignore
tasks.description: Setup Rust workspace structure containing bcopy binary and core library.

tasks.name: Implement Win32 Device Profiler
tasks.description: Identify seek penalty (HDD vs SSD) and drive/enclosure type (UASP vs BOT) using IOCTLs.

tasks.name: Implement Tree Walk & Queue Classifier
tasks.description: Traverse directory trees safely (avoiding reparse/junction loops, supporting MAX_PATH bypass) and categorize into small (<1MB) vs large (>=1MB) queues.

tasks.name: Implement Multi-threaded Copy Engine
tasks.description: Execute copying using dedicated small/large file worker pools, implementing the one-handle rule, unbuffered I/O for large files, and robust error handling.

tasks.name: Implement Two-Phase Move
tasks.description: Ensure transactional safety for moves: copy first, verify, then delete. Optimize same-volume moves via renaming.

tasks.name: Implement Device-Gone Resilience & Cancel/Pause
tasks.description: Detect USB disconnects to pause/poll. Support thread-execution state to prevent sleep, clean partial files on cancel.

tasks.name: Create Benchmark Harness (bench/run.ps1)
tasks.description: Generate 800MB tiny-file fixture and benchmark bcopy vs robocopy.

tasks.name: Run Benchmarks & Collect Results
tasks.description: Execute benchmark on user's specific hardware to verify performance advantages.

milestones.name: Milestone 2: Trigger
milestones.description: Implement foreground gating, RegisterHotKey, rename-box check, and clipboard/Explorer resolution.

tasks.name: Setup Message-Only Win32 Window & Hotkey Registration
tasks.description: Register Ctrl+Shift+V globally but activate only when Explorer/Desktop is focused.

tasks.name: Implement Foreground Gating & Rename Guard
tasks.description: Use SetWinEventHook for focus shifts. Unregister hotkey or pass-through if focus is in a rename Edit box.

tasks.name: Resolve Clipboard Source List & Drop Effects
tasks.description: Read CF_HDROP and CFSTR_PREFERREDDROPEFFECT (cut vs copy) from Windows clipboard.

tasks.name: Resolve Explorer Destination Path
tasks.description: Enumerate shell windows using COM (IShellWindows) to find the path of the active Explorer window.

tasks.name: Verify Trigger Behavior & Key Interception
tasks.description: Manually test that the hotkey works in Explorer/Desktop and doesn't steal key combinations in other apps.

milestones.name: Milestone 3: Progress UI & Preflight
milestones.description: Integrate Tauri, build custom progress UI, taskbar integration, and preflight checks.

tasks.name: Initialize Tauri & Create Progress Window Lifecycle
tasks.description: Create hidden progress window on startup, support native taskbar progress bar states, and control show/hide behavior.

tasks.name: Implement Preflight Checks
tasks.description: Check free space, reject UNC/network paths, check copy-into-self, and run writability probe.

tasks.name: Develop Progress UI Dashboard
tasks.description: Build high-aesthetic HTML/CSS page showing aggregated speed, ETA, decision lines, and multiple stacked jobs.

tasks.name: Final Integration & Manual Acceptance Testing
tasks.description: User validates UI look and feel, error handling overlays, and performs final end-to-end tests.
